fields.main_conclusion: The paper proves that the Stäckel matrix defining separable, orthogonal curvilinear coordinate systems on a flat manifold is exactly the derivative of the Abel-Jacobi map (the Brill-Noether matrix) on an associated hyperelliptic algebraic curve, and uses this identification to construct Lax pairs, r-matrix algebras, and flat coordinates unifying a broad family of integrable mechanical (Stäckel) systems.
fields.construct_pair: Derivative of the Abel-Jacobi map (Brill-Noether matrix) on a hyperelliptic curve -> Stäckel matrix / separable coordinate structure of integrable mechanical systems
fields.methods_surface_summary: Pure mathematical physics: the paper derives theorems (via algebraic geometry, symplectic geometry, and Lax-pair/r-matrix formalism) connecting the Abel-Jacobi map on hyperelliptic curves to the classical Stäckel theorem, with no empirical data, participants, or measurements of any kind.
